description.purpose: GET-only HTTP client: fetches the URL from the inbound tool_call args and emits the response body as one tool_result turn.
description.use_when: The `web_fetch` occupant of a tools hive, reached on hop.tool_name == 'web_fetch'. GET only -- POST/headers/body are a core roadmap defer.
description.not_in_scope: No method/header/body control, no retries. Non-2xx is a normal tool_result with hop.http_status -- routing decides. And NO `params.sandbox`: this cell carries none, which is the shipped truth rather than an omission -- its whole job is egress, so `network: deny` would turn it off, and the process sandbox has no notion of an allowed host. It is therefore one of the two occupants that widen the sandbox union this template declares, and it is meant to be readable as such.
description.emits_meaning: messages[]: one tool_result turn, text = response body. hop.http_status drives the 2xx edge; error_code only on io_error/timeout/invalid_input.
description.consumes_meaning: messages[]: a tool_call turn whose text is JSON args {url}.
